known.workaround: Refs come from get_interactives, navigate and find_text; run one of them again, or pass a selector. Before 1.19.0 each of those calls renumbered refs from n1, so an old ref could point at another element.
The tab is probably hidden (window minimized or covered): get_page_info reports visibility. Bring the window on screen, or create_tab with new_window and bounds.
The window is not rendering frames (minimized or fully covered). Bring it at least partially on screen and retry.
The window is not rendering frames (minimized or fully covered). Bring it at least partially on screen and retry.
The tab was closed or replaced: get_tabs reports closed_session_tabs with the reason (1.18.0+). Open a new one with create_tab and use its id.
